text: As Potter and his bride rounded the corner near their new home, they came face to face with a man in a maroon colored shirt, who was feverishly reloading. <break time="0.8s" /> In an instant the man dropped the revolver to the ground, and like lightning whipped another from its holster and aimed it at the bridegrooms chest. <break time="0.8s" /> The brides face had gone as yellow as old cloth, and Potter, who had no weapon with him, stood perfectly still before the gleaming revolver. <break time="0.8s" /> You tried to sneak up on me, Scratchy said with a sneer, and when Potter calmly answered that he had no gun with him, Scratchy refused to believe it. <break time="0.8s" /> I have no gun because I have just come from San Antonio with my wife, said Potter distinctly, and I am married, Scratchy. <break time="0.8s" /> Married, said Scratchy, and like a creature allowed a glimpse of another world, he stepped back and asked, Is this the lady. <break time="0.8s" /> When Potter said yes, Scratchy said slowly, Well, I suppose it is all off now, for he was only a simple child of the earlier plains. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked up his fallen revolver, put both weapons in their holsters, and went away, and his feet made funnel shaped tracks in the heavy sand.
